svg.aria-label: Terminal: whoami. Ly Rizzler (deadly-7), I build Discord bots. Miyu: a private music and community bot on Node.js 22, discord.js v14, Lavalink v4 and SQLite. Music from YouTube, YouTube Music, Spotify and SoundCloud, 11 filter presets, antinuke, raid detection, automod, 24/7 mode. Motto: I'm the conqueror of my fate.
